market_summary: During the late New York session, markets are universally dominated by post-expansion consolidation and low-volume drift. EURUSD and GBPUSD remain pinned against their lower ATR bands near session lows without the RVOL > 2.0 required for breakdown confirmation. US100 has rebounded above its Gamma Flip (27808) into a Positive Dampening regime but is choked immediately below Call Wall #1 (27879) and EMA20. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and BTCUSD are churning inside or beneath their session Value Areas beneath down-sloping VWAP and EMA50 baselines with diverging CVD slopes and no yellow volume breakouts. High discipline dictates a HOLD across all six symbols until liquid expansion triggers materialize.

signals.rationale: Price is trading inside the session Value Area (VAL 3876.49 to VAH 3900.85) and below POC 3894.76, indicating rotational mean-reversion conditions. RVOL is weak at 0.658 with no yellow volume confirmation on the recent test. Options GEX is in a POSITIVE_DAMPENING regime with price hovering immediately above Gamma Flip at 3885.87, capped tightly by resistance S/R 3887.45 and Call Wall #1 at 3897.11 with Put Wall #1 down at 3875.28. Confluence is lacking for directional follow-through.

signals.level_event: rejection at S/R 3887.45 and Gamma Flip 3885.87
